recommended_dosage.dilution_ratio_per_acre: 400 ml to 500 ml in 200 Litres of water

labels.antidote_instructions_en: Administer Atropine sulphate intravenously (2-4 mg every 10-15 minutes until signs of atropinization occur). Pralidoxime (2-PAM) may be administered under strict physician guidance. Do not induce vomiting if patient is unconscious.
labels.environmental_hazards: Extremely toxic to fish, aquatic invertebrates, and pollinator honeybees. Avoid spraying during bloom.
labels.verification_status: Reviewed and Approved by Agricultural Safety Board

recommended_dosage.dilution_ratio_per_acre: 100 ml to 150 ml in 200 Litres of water

ppe_required: Long trousers and full sleeve shirt
labels.antidote_instructions_en: No specific antidote known. Treat symptomatically and give gastric lavage if swallowed. Maintain electrolyte balance.
labels.environmental_hazards: Highly toxic to honeybees. Do not apply when bees are actively foraging in the field.
labels.verification_status: Reviewed and Approved by Agricultural Safety Board

recommended_dosage.dilution_ratio_per_acre: 600 g to 800 g in 300 Litres of water

labels.antidote_instructions_en: No specific antidote known. Empty stomach by gastric lavage with warm sodium bicarbonate solution. Treat symptomatically.
labels.environmental_hazards: Toxic to fish. Do not contaminate pond water, irrigation canals, or water sources.
labels.verification_status: Reviewed and Approved by Agricultural Safety Board
